T: Talkies, a party cake and a very wet walk home.
D: A silent film star and a chorus girl help Hollywood make the jump to talking pictures.
P: Serve the cake when Kathy pops out of it at the party.
S: Prunes stuffed with almonds, wrapped in bacon and baked crisp
Pitted prunes stuffed with almonds and wrapped in bacon, baked crisp and served on sticks.
Crisp cheddar toasties with hot tomato soup to dunk
Buttered white bread with cheddar toasted in a pan until golden, cut into soldiers for dunking in tomato soup.
halved whites piped with mustard mayo yolk, crispy bacon crumbs, chives and pickled mustard seeds

Boiled eggs with yolks whipped with mayo, mustard and paprika, piped back in and topped with crispy bacon crumbs, chives and pickled mustard seeds. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 80g mayo, 2 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp white vinegar, salt and a pinch of paprika until smooth. Pipe back into the whites. Fry 4 bacon rashers until very crisp and chop fine. Simmer 2 tbsp yellow mustard seeds in 3 tbsp vinegar and 1 tsp sugar for 5 minutes. Top each egg with bacon, mustard seeds, chives and paprika.
M: Chicken, mushrooms and capsicum in cream sauce, in puff pastry cases
Diced chicken, mushrooms and red capsicum simmered in a creamy sherry sauce, then spooned into warm puff pastry cases.
Premiere night roast beef with Yorkshires
sirloin carved pink, puffed batter puddings, horseradish cream and wine gravy, for The Royal Rascal

Beef sirloin roasted pink and carved thin, with puffed Yorkshire puddings, crunchy roast potatoes, horseradish cream and a rich red wine gravy. Heat the oven to 220C. Parboil 1kg potatoes 8 minutes, rough up and roast in oil 50 minutes. Season a 1.2kg sirloin, sear and roast 30 to 35 minutes for medium rare, then rest 15 minutes. Whisk 140g plain flour, 3 eggs and 200ml milk. Heat 1 tsp oil in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin until smoking, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices, 150ml red wine and 300ml stock. Mix 150ml whipped cream with 2 tbsp horseradish.
W: Layer cake with pink vanilla buttercream and sprinkles
A tall vanilla layer cake with pink buttercream and sprinkles, big enough to hide a chorus girl.
K: Homemade lemon syrup topped with sparkling water
Fresh lemon syrup topped with sparkling water and poured into old-fashioned coupe glasses with a lemon twist.

steps.text: Push an almond into each prune.
Shave the eggplant lengthways into 24 thin strips with a peeler and brush with the oil, paprika, maple syrup and salt.
Wrap each prune in a strip of eggplant and secure with a toothpick.
Bake at 200C until the eggplant is crisp.

Heat the tomato soup and pour into mugs.
Cut the toasties into soldiers and serve for dunking.

steps.text: Beat the cake butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk. Divide between two 20cm tins.

Cool completely.
Beat the icing butter with the icing sugar and a drop of pink colouring.
Stack and cover the layers, then shower with sprinkles.

s.note: Prunes stuffed with almonds, wrapped in bacon and baked crisp
s.how: Push an almond into each of 24 pitted prunes. Wrap each in a third of a bacon rasher, secure with a toothpick and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

s.note: Crisp cheddar toasties with hot tomato soup to dunk
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread on the outside and fill 4 with 200g grated cheddar. Toast in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted. Cut into soldiers and serve with 800ml hot tomato soup in mugs for dunking.

m.note: Chicken, mushrooms and capsicum in cream sauce, in puff pastry cases
m.how: Fry 600g diced chicken breast in butter, then add 200g sliced mushrooms and 1 diced red capsicum. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, then 300ml cream and 125ml stock and simmer 8 minutes until thick. Spoon into 8 puff pastry cases baked at 200C for 15 minutes.

w.note: Layer cake with pink vanilla buttercream and sprinkles
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 300g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake in two 20cm tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar and a drop of pink colouring, stack and cover the layers, then shower with sprinkles.

d.note: Homemade lemon syrup topped with sparkling water
d.how: Simmer 100g sugar with 100ml water and the zest of 2 lemons until dissolved, cool and add the juice of 4 lemons. Pour 40ml into each of 4 coupe glasses and top with chilled sparkling water and a lemon twist.
